title: A key sign-in is checked by the app itself against the registry
assertion: After the provider has verified the assertion: a key the provider holds and the registry does not is refused in the words of a wrong credential, recorded, and counts no failure; a removed key is refused, recorded and pages with IDs only (`security event: removed hardware key used`); an assertion the provider accepts but the registered public key did not sign is refused and logged by the error's class name alone, and a response whose id is not its rawId is refused as malformed; the cleaning deletes at the provider, with the member's own grant, a removed credential and an unknown one older than fifteen minutes, never a live key or a young unknown one
noFileReason: Synthetic personas and keys the tests make in memory (a software authenticator, a provider twin); no file.
